Model Academy: Residual XGBoost (Elite Star De-Meaner)
Architecture, Mathematical Mechanics & Out-of-Sample Performance
▼
🧠 Architecture & Mechanism

Trains on the de-meaned player residual: Δy = y - μ_dual_EB, then re-adds the Empirical Bayes baseline at inference. Eliminates elite star shrinkage.

Test MAE2.21 pts
Spearman ρ0.435
Top-15% PR-AUC0.326
2024–2025 Pts2,610.8 (2024) / 2,945.6 (2025)
⚖️ Operational Trade-offs

Pros: Reduces elite star prediction bias by 86% (solves the 'Arrascaeta Problem'); accurately values high-floor superstars.

Cons: Slightly more sensitive to sudden tactical role changes or mid-season tactical demotions.
